steps.npc: I'm James. It's my job to tell you all there is to know about Old School Bonds.

options.text: What is an Old School Bond?

steps.npc: An Old School Bond will allow you to buy membership for your account using in game gold pieces.
My sources have also informed me that due to popular demand, they can now be redeemed for a free name change! Handy!

options.text: How do I buy an Old School Bond in game?

steps.npc: You can get an Old School Bond from other players or from the Grand Exchange.

options.text: How do I turn an Old School Bond into membership?

steps.npc: Simply click the bond and choose the redeem option.

options.text: How much membership do I get from an Old School bond?

steps.npc: You get 14 days membership from an Old School Bond.

options.text: Can I use an Old School Bond to pay for anything else?

steps.npc: At the moment Old School Bonds can only be redeemed for membership and for display name changes.

options.text: How do I buy an Old School Bond to give or sell to another player?

steps.npc: Open the Bond Pouch from the Controls Settings and follow the instructions to buy a bond. You can then give the bond to another player or sell it on the Grand Exchange.
